static_source_trace: Worker original data epoch is captured before file reads; common adapter dispatch and runner direct/archive/bundle child paths bind it without opening bytes.
All seven typed adapters require this original value before decoding or staging; each source request retains it across prefixes and retries.
Location checks the original value inside each existing 256-point Room batch at admission and completion.

Activity, Pressure, ambient Steps and captured/background radio source writers already compare expectedCollectedDataEpoch inside their owning Room transactions; radio child attachment repeats it for every bounded batch.
Session Steps v1 receipt and v2 contracts now require the original epoch; the existing Room importer compares it inside the transaction and preserves its existing lifecycle/retention rollback guards.

The legacy direct Steps API remains source-compatible through an optional epoch; file dispatch always supplies the required pinned value. No alternate import pipeline, schema, file format or consent grant was added.
authored_scenarios: Missing original epoch rejects all seven typed adapters before bytes or writer resolution.
Lazy direct/archive stream binding, idempotence, rebinding rejection, closed stream and negative epoch.
Location stale direct/archive input, clear while staging, no inserted points and staged file cleanup.
Pressure prefix import keeps its initial epoch after a clear instead of admitting later entries under the new epoch.
Activity and ambient Steps reject stale original epochs rather than adopting post-decode current state.
Wi-Fi and Cell decoding preserves the original epoch through source requests and retries; rejected sources cannot attach children.
Session Steps stale legacy/v1/v2 file requests and lifecycle change after payload insertion roll back payload, summary and dirty effects.
Direct retry, ZIP dispatch and bundle child retry keep one original epoch alongside durable file receipts.
remaining: No tests, compilation, schema checks or device gates executed.
R16 user-edited Location replacement requires the pending approved durable correction/rebuild path; no Replace UI enabled here.
R17 production bundle route remains owned by completion_wiring; the shared runner now supplies its child epoch context.
R18 physical transfer cancellation and draining remain a separate pending architecture slice.
